conclusions.provenance: Pinned original reports, full native arrays, oracle vectors, actual RTL text and NPY bind both compact corpora. Independent re-extraction is byte-identical, and independently vectorized producer/transpose/sign mappings match all real pairs. Official local source hash agrees with historical pin. No model-native expectations regenerated.
conclusions.independence: C volatile binary32/fenv operations and comparison/parity BF16 conversion are algorithmically independent of Python integer dyadics. All 18 trace words per variant match for 163840 real and 7207 synthetic pairs on this host.
conclusions.fail_closed: Normal and optimized admissions preserve require gates. Direct checks reject every corrupted fixture, invalid input type/nonfinite input in all operand positions, malformed C rows, overflows and the repaired invalid UF waiver.
conclusions.metrics: All four comparison families over all five groups per corpus/variant independently recomputed, including differences, absolute errors, unchanged thresholds, direction, signed zero, ULP histogram/quantiles and terminal max witnesses.
conclusions.protocol: Not newly tested; historical original RTL outputs/flags retained and replayed only.
conclusions.physical_implementation: Candidate RTL, coefficient generation, packing/storage integration, timing and synthesis untested; no production arithmetic changed.
conclusions.qor: No candidate PPA, performance or useful-wall MAC utilization conclusion is supported.
